hero.name: Nguyễn Thanh Hà Huy
hero.role: Frontend Developer building fast, accessible interfaces with React & Next.js.
hero.pitch: 4+ years shipping production web apps in React and Next.js for clients across Canada, France, the Netherlands and Vietnam. Comfortable across both Next.js routers, TypeScript and modern state management — from pixel-accurate Figma builds to Core Web Vitals and technical SEO.

about.title: Background & approach
about.p1: Coming from an Electronics & Telecommunications Engineering background, I pivoted into software and have spent 4+ years specializing in frontend development — building React and Next.js applications for projects across Vietnam, France, Canada and the Netherlands. Beyond turning Figma designs into pixel-perfect interfaces, I focus on UI/UX thinking and contribute to design systems to keep the codebase consistent and easy to scale. Optimizing Core Web Vitals, applying lazy loading, code splitting and technical SEO are non-negotiable standards for getting the best performance.
about.p2: Peer code review is a core part of how I work, not a formality — catching bugs and enforcing conventions across every team I've been on. Outside day-to-day frontend work, I've been using Claude Code to direct and review a NestJS/Prisma/PostgreSQL backend build — a structured way to grow into the backend side, without overclaiming skills I'm still building.
